REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)

REPUBLIC OF TAJIKISTAN

TAJIKISTAN DIGITAL FOUNDATIONS PROJECT

Date: November 9, 2026

Assignment Title: Consultancy Service for Advanced Digital Skills Trainings for 1,000 individuals

Reference No.: PIC-TDFP-CS-3

State Institution "Projects Implementation Center for Tajikistan Digital Foundations" of the Executive Office of the President of the Republic of Tajikistan is implementing Tajikistan Digital Foundation Project (thereafter referred to as Project) co-financed by the World Bank and the Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation (SDC). The total cost of the project is US$46.2 million, of which the IDA grant is $30M, SDC Trust fund is $14.8M and GoTJ share is $1.4M. and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include the Advanced Digital Skills Trainings for 1,000 individuals

 

The consultant will have to perform the following tasks:

  • Ensure blended and online delivery modalities through the Platform for Educational Needs, describing delivery options, sequencing, and implementation considerations to support regional equity of access and sustainability beyond the project period.
  • Develop an inclusive outreach and participant selection framework, including eligibility criteria and targeting approaches, to support the participation of youth, NEET populations, women, persons with disabilities, and beneficiaries in line with the inclusion targets defined in the Objective section.

    The total duration of the contract is 24 months.

     

    The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following website: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1avZ1BiaGMRme-LLyzJU5MgukzT2-brdg/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=101229496586602350179&rtpof=true&sd=true

    The State Institution "Projects Implementation Center for Tajikistan Digital Foundations" of the Executive Office of the President of the Republic of Tajikistan now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

    The shortlisting criteria are:

    (i) At least 3 years of experience in designing and delivering educational programs.

    (ii) Demonstrated experience in designing and implementation managing large-scale digital skills and workforce development programs of at least 800–1000 participants within

e Procurement Regulations.

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 08:00 to 17:00 hours.

The deadline for submission of Expressions of Interest has been extended. Expressions of Interest (including the firm’s profile, relevant experience, supporting documents for reference contracts, primary legal documents, etc.) must be delivered in written form to the address below (in person or by e-mail) no later than November 27, 2026, at 17:00 (GMT+5).

State Institution "Projects Implementation Center for Tajikistan Digital Foundations" of the Executive Office of the President of the Republic of Tajikistan, 59 Shotemur street, Dushanbe.

BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVE The Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) Office of Infrastructure Research & Development (HRDI) conducts and oversees research and development programs and projects that address critical highway infrastructure needs and priorities of national importance. Research studies focus on the design, materials, construction, operation, and preservation of highway pavements, bridges, and other structure

rs, engineers, and transportation agencies nationwide through the FHWA InfoHighway™ data portals (https://infohighway.fhwa.dot.gov). FHWA InfoHighway provides centralized access to research-quality infrastructure performance data, supporting data-driven pavement engineering, predictive modeling, and State DOT decision-making. The primary mission of the LPES contract is direct support for the LTPP program, consolidating field data collection, pavement research analytics, and long-term data management; additionally, the contract provides direct and indirect data support to related FHWA infrastructure research programs. 2 OBJECTIVE/SCOPE OF WORK The main objective of this contract is to provide highly specialized engineering services, including field survey operations, data quality management, scientific data curation, and technology transfer support services for the LTPP program and related highway infrastructure research initiatives. This requirement demands comprehensive technical expertise spanning pavement, bridge, and other highway infrastructure engineering, as well as advanced data systems: Specifically, the LPES contract vehicle is structured to achieve the following overarching strategic objectives: • Execute comprehensive pavement condition data collection, incor

earch- grade data quality. • Formulate strategic pavement research plans advancing the LTPP program, conduct targeted performance case studies, and deliver practical engineering tools, Section 508- compliant publications, and technical webinars. • Develop and curate specialized, analysis-ready datasets for machine learning (ML) and predictive modeling across LTPP and broader highway infrastructure domains, integrating modern database architectures and coordinating data schemas with web portal contractors for public release. To fulfill the LTPP program mission and support broader FHWA pavement and other infrastructure research, the scope of work is organized across three (3) primary Task Areas. Contractors are not required to perform across all Task Areas unless awarded task orders in those areas: • Task Area A – Data Collection and Processing: The Contractor shall provide all labor, contractor-owned survey vehicles, specialized diagnostic equipment, materials, and traffic control services necessary to perform automated high-speed 3D surface condition profiling, as well as deflection testing using the Traffic-Speed Deflection Device (TSDD) and Falling Weight Deflectometer (FWD) methods.
